### 2026-10-05 — # Researching esp32 options

**2h**

# Researching esp32 options
## accomplished:
- found best currently stocked `ESP32` module to use.

## time/process breakdown:
**10 minutes in:** found a comparison sheet for what looks like every ` esp32`, [here](https://products.espressif.com/api/user/file/Espressif_SoC_Product_Portfolio.pdf) (screenshot below)
![IMG_4289](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/32W6I9TEQLrd7TpDxb0Wz6JR8YCTB2qd/5f89c08e1b1d4376d92291433f3910f9ca0cb3c010cfabb7a519ee557d885c8d.jpeg)

**23 minutes in: **will go with a module, not a lone soc to avoid needing more circuitry

**41 minutes in: **after narrowing down the options by removing choices with no wifi or only 1 I2C connection, i will likely be going with the ` ESP32-S31`  of some kind, it looks to be the most powerful and versatile

![IMG_4287](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/32W6I9TEQLrd7TpDxb0Wz6JR8YCTB2qd/42a580f79553a12e67854ce473f7acc8c9c101bc0528cb72579f549bb93ed33b.jpeg)

**45 minutes in: **almost certainly using the ` ESP32-S31`. Will find somewhere to purchase it and find the best variation/ module  next.
![IMG_4290](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/32W6I9TEQLrd7TpDxb0Wz6JR8YCTB2qd/91678fc3b1b352bc55c56d585da7f9a5fbeeaaac87a561848c46cfad68854cdb.jpeg)

**48 minutes in: **the non-soc options are either `ESP32-S31-WROOM-1` or `-ESP32-S31-WROOM-3` (preferably want the U versions,  as they have an antenna connector rather than built in pcb antenna)

**52 minutes in: **` ESP32-S31-WROOM-1U` is **not** smd and is also smaller, this is better as I can fit more on the pcb and also hand solder more parts easier.

**60 minutes in:** Did not find `ESP32-S31-WROOM-1U` for sale, will go with `ESP32-S31-WROOM-1` instead (pcb antenna rather than connector)
[digekey uk](https://www.digikey.co.uk/en/products/detail/espressif-systems/ESP32-S31-WROOM-1-N16R16V)

The rest of the time was been spent going over all of my notes to make sure everything checks out along with accumulating all notes and pictures into one place and writing it neatly with rich text (so cool).

.

### 2026-10-06 — # Finding info and kicad files

**2h**

# Finding info and kicad files
## accomplished:
- chose different `ESP32` board as the `ESP32-S31` lacks community support
-  found espressif library

## time/process breakdown:
started: 9:00, ended: 10:55

**9:05:** looking for `ESP32-S31` files for kicad, also lacks support for
circuitpython.

**9:55:** did not find `ESP32-S31` files for kicad. Did find a lot of complexity and a lack of support, will decide on a different module.

**10:00:** taking a break.

**10:15:** break over.

**10:20:** best option seems to be either the `ESP32-C6-WROOM-1U` or the `ESP32-C5-WROOM-1U` (it also means i can have an antenna connector rather than a pc antenna!)
![IMG_4291](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/32W6I9TEQLrd7TpDxb0Wz6JR8YCTB2qd/5ce440056c77cbeb745ad7789111b68adb999eab6dbe9614040ad52212497689.png)

**10:25:** i will go with `ESP32-C6-WROOM-1U` as the only upside of the `ESP32-C5-WROOM-1U` that i can understand is dual band wifi. the `ESP32-C6-WROOM-1U` has a higher max operating temp and more pins too. i have chosen the `ESP32-C6-WROOM-1U` as it has castelated solder pads rather than smd along with the formerly mentoned antenna connector. i will now try and find a place to buy it

**10:30:** the best option i can find is the `ESP32-C6-WROOM-1U-N8` option (`N8` meaning 8mb of flash mem) on digikey, [here](https://www.digikey.co.uk/en/products/detail/espressif-systems/ESP32-C6-WROOM-1U-N8/20685870)
![IMG_4292](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/32W6I9TEQLrd7TpDxb0Wz6JR8YCTB2qd/701a89acf47c5c76946926db3b9e42a9da14c1dc28fd894900d2a0d92cfa6ac3.jpeg)

**10:55**: cant install library, stopping for now.

.
